args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Actions taken: rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: the first rollback attempt was a partial failure (only us-east rolled back due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollback to all regions. Post-rollback health verified: service healthy in all three regions with a 0.2% error rate. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failures still needs investigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it's fixed.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt was a partial failure (only us-east updated, due to an orchestrator error), so I retried, and the second attempt completed the rollback across all regions.
2. **Verified health:** Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all three regions with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident:** Created incident **INC-0001** documenting the v2.3.1 health check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the partial-failure and retry), and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Note:** The root cause of the v2.3.1 failures is still unknown — the incident notes flag that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it's investigated.
